critique.evidence: The oversized “Detection changes the business model” thesis and attacker-ledger framing give the screen a clear story, with the 25.60× ROI dial serving as a recognizable focal point. However, the actual visual language remains a conventional before/after table plus circular KPI gauge, rather than a distinctive economics visualization. The tablet capture also has the navigation bar cutting across the hero, weakening the demo moment.
critique.fix: Replace the generic KPI dial with a signature attacker-economics visualization—such as an animated adaptation-cost curve crossing break-even and collapsing success yield—directly connected to the ledger rows. Preserve a clean, unobstructed hero at tablet width.
